research_problem: Black-box REST testing fails on complex input formats and inter-parameter dependencies; prior NLP/LLM spec enhancers are static and LLM APIs are costly/private
technical_approach: Two Llama3-8B models fine-tuned with QLoRA (IPD rules from 551 params; enum example values from 4,133 APIs.guru specs), quantized (2/4/8-bit), invoked inside ARAT-RL Q-learning when repeated 4xx occur, using parameter descriptions + server response messages
primary_contribution: LlamaRestTest: small, local, fine-tuned LMs that use runtime server feedback for REST testing
dataset_benchmark: 12 services (9 open-source, 3 online: FDIC, Ohsome, Spotify); RESTGPT ground-truth for values (7 services) and IPDs (3 services, 18 rules)
evaluation_metrics: semantic validity precision (2 external raters); correct IPD rules; JaCoCo method/branch/line coverage; processed operations; unique 500 errors
baselines: RESTGPT, base Llama3-8B; RESTler, EvoMaster, ARAT-RL, MoRest (with RESTGPT-enhanced specs)
key_findings: Value validity 72.44% (FT) vs RESTGPT 68.82% vs base 22.94%; 12/18 IPD rules vs RESTGPT 9; 8-bit quantized best testing config (55.8% method, 37.5 ops); +10-22.7 pp method coverage over tools; 204 vs 130-160 500-errors; ablation: IPD model and server messages matter most
author_limitations: 12 services; dataset dependence; limited tool comparison; possibly suboptimal settings; script bugs; ARAT-RL dependence; weaker on uninformative server messages; 2-bit degrades
analyst_limitations: Fault gain vs ARAT-RL (44) entirely from Ohsome+Spotify; no statistical tests; quantization>FT likely time-budget confound; tiny homogeneous IPD eval (13/18 YouTube type=video); RESTGPT used both to build training labels and as ground truth; 500-only oracle; same-group baselines; internal inconsistencies (22.94 vs 24.94; 17 vs 18 rules)
reproducibility: Tool, models and data released; inference on consumer laptop; fine-tuning needs A100 (Colab); online services drift
suggested_extensions: Equal-call/equal-time re-evaluation with statistics; non-enum value fine-tuning; study effect of error-message informativeness; feed learned IPDs back into spec (spec repair)
evidence_location: Approach p.7-10; Table 2 p.11; Tables 3-4 p.12; RQ2 p.14-15; RQ3 p.16-17; ablation Table 7 p.18; threats p.19
integrity: Tables reconstructable; coverage figures absent; Table 4 symbol columns uncertain
